name: Apsis Aerocom Ltd
tagline: Tiny newly-listed precision defence/aerospace machining SME - real policy tailwind and a first material defence order, but still almost no independent track record and priced for perfection
business_overview: BSE/NSE EMERGE SME (listed ~mid-2025) making precision-machined components and assemblies for aerospace, defence and healthcare; debt-free, very small revenue base.
fundamentals_table: Rs 7.24 Cr domestic defence supply order, ~10-month execution (customer undisclosed)
fundamentals_narrative: Still a genuinely early-stage micro-cap: annualised revenue is only ~Rs 27-30 Cr against a ~Rs 630 Cr market cap (~20x+ sales, ~50x+ earnings). The Rs 7.24 Cr defence order is material against that base (~half a year's revenue) and confirms the company is winning indigenisation-linked work, but it is a single confidential order, not a proven pipeline.
sentiment_summary: No new forum activity - thread still just 4 posts, no independent stress-testing of the business exists yet.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users; the only substantive community input remains a generic caution that SME/small-cap IPO numbers can be dressed up pre-listing.
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: Rs 7.24 Cr domestic defence supply order (2026-05-08 datapoint), ~10-month execution, customer undisclosed on confidentiality grounds - material vs the ~Rs 27 Cr annualised revenue base.
Still SME-board listed with ~14 months of public history; stock has run ~4x from IPO price.
bull_case: Debt-free precision-machining SME in the defence/aerospace indigenisation theme
First disclosed defence order (Rs 7.24 Cr) is large relative to the revenue base
Very small size - room to compound if order flow becomes repeatable
bear_case: Extremely short track record (~14 months listed); essentially no independent community validation
Annualised revenue ~Rs 27 Cr against ~Rs 630 Cr market cap - already priced for strong execution
One confidential order does not establish a pipeline or margin durability
Thin thread (4 posts) - no independent scrutiny
verdict_headline: Re-verification: the Rs 7.24 Cr defence order is a real, material datapoint, but one order is not a track record and the stock is already priced for perfection - 'neither' at Low conviction stands
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The lead datapoint is verified and is material against this micro-cap's base, so it is a genuine positive - but a single confidential order does not create a credible 10x path when annualised revenue is ~Rs 27 Cr and the market cap is already ~Rs 630 Cr (~20x+ sales).
The prior 'too early to call' concerns are unchanged: ~14 months of history, zero independent community scrutiny, a ~4x run from issue price.
No change: thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Low, no red flag. Worth another look in 1-2 quarters once there are more post-listing results and independent coverage.

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: single confidential order is genuine but 'a single confidential order does not create a credible 10x path' at ~20x+ sales (valuation=no); only 14 months of history, zero independent scrutiny.
